description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the UserProfile page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It manages user profile data retrieval from a SQL Server database based on session information, and handles navigation between pages such as dashboard, leaderboard, and login.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing the user profile page, handling page load events and button click events for navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves user info from database if session exists, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Currently does nothing; placeholder for profile button functionality.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the login page to logout.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the taken courses page.
